• **Mon / Wed / Fri** – Full-body gym sessions (~45 min each)
• **Walking** – Fit in 2–3 walks (20–30 min) on rest days or post-workout for extra calorie burn and recovery

**Nutrition (vegetarian):**
• **~1,900 kcal/day** *(starting estimate—refine later with weight)*
• **~130 g protein/day** *(starting estimate—refine later with weight)*

Focus on high-protein vegetarian sources: Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, lentils, chickpeas, tofu, tempeh, eggs, and protein powder if you like. Pair with plenty of vegetables, whole grains, and healthy fats.

**No calendar conflicts** found, so you have a clear week to get started!
